title: Joshua Encourages the Sons of Joseph to Clear the Forest
description: The sons of Joseph complain to Joshua that they have received only one portion, even though they are a numerous people. Joshua replies that they should go up into the forest in the land of the Perizzites and Refaim and clear out territory for themselves. When they object that the Canaanites in the valley regions have iron chariots, Joshua promises them that the mountain will be theirs all the way to its outer limits, and that they will drive out the Canaanites.
